description: Core V Rising spells organized by school and role. Includes travel spells, basic spells, and ultimate abilities referenced across build guides. Not exhaustive — covers spells used in recommended builds.

travel.name: Veil of Blood
travel.description: Dash through enemies, healing on contact
travel.notes: Best all-around travel spell for PvE. Heal + dash through enemies gives both mobility and sustain.

travel.name: Veil of Chaos
travel.description: Illusion dash that leaves a clone behind. Clone recasts your next spell.
travel.notes: Double cast Chaos Volley through clone for surprise burst. Best travel spell for PvP.

travel.name: Veil of Frost
travel.description: Dash leaving a trail of frost that slows enemies
travel.notes: Situationally useful for controlling chokepoints and creating space.

basic.name: Chaos Volley
basic.description: Fire two projectiles dealing damage. Landing both does 15-20% of a player's HP in PvP.
basic.notes: Most versatile basic spell. Ranged option for melee builds, pressure tool for PvP, boss puller for PvE.

basic.name: Sanguine Coil
basic.description: Ranged projectile that heals you on hit
basic.notes: Heal on hit — essential for melee builds that take constant damage. Use between boss mechanics.

basic.name: Frost Barrier
basic.description: Absorbs incoming damage and slows attackers
basic.notes: Pop before charging heavy or engaging. Absorbs their counter-burst and the slow gives you a free attack window.

basic.name: Raise Skeleton
basic.description: Summon 2 permanent skeletons that tank for you
basic.notes: Core Summoner spell. Skeletons draw boss aggro and tank mechanics. Always keep these active.

basic.name: Summon Banshee
basic.description: Summon a ranged spellcaster that deals magic damage and applies slow
basic.notes: Place 5-8 tiles behind skeletons. Projectiles slow enemies — against fast bosses, the slow is more valuable than her damage.

basic.name: Corpse Explosion
basic.description: Detonate dead skeletons for burst AoE magic damage
basic.notes: Optional alternative to Banshee. Turn skeleton deaths into damage.

ultimate.name: Heart Strike
ultimate.description: Massive single-target burst that heals you for damage dealt
ultimate.notes: Your finisher. Combined with charged heavy + Q, this deletes 20-30% of a boss HP bar in one window. In PvP, kills through most defensive spells.

ultimate.name: Army of the Dead
ultimate.notes: Your boss-killing cooldown. Pop when boss is stationary or CC'd. Get 1-2 uses per boss fight. Never waste when boss is about to jump or phase-transition.
